summary: The silence broke. 81 messages this week (32 from Lauren) versus 8 and one word last week - her most active week since onboarding. The turn actually started late on Aug 14, hours after last week's snapshot closed: she came back with "Just saw thank you", "Filming today", and a livestream-poll request. This week she shot and uploaded two of the three customs, dropped a full Zeus shoot into the marketing drive, and when Ollie flagged a fan spending $6.3k in a day she sent personalized pics and a video within 40 minutes while driving home - "Run it up fam" and "Bravo team!! That's what we love to see!!". So the churn read from last week was wrong: she was heads-down filming, not leaving. Two things sour it. First, the content-boundary complaint did not just stay open, it recurred concretely: on Aug 14 she found a custom on the sheet sold as "topless Joi with face", 12 days after Ollie said "Will get this sorted" on Aug 2, and she had to restate her boundary a third time on Aug 18. Second, and more serious, invoice 2 landed on Aug 15 (period Aug 1-14) with a changed bank account number, no Meta ad-spend report attached, and Derrek's promised ad-stats call still not made 18 days on - and she has not replied to it or sent a wire confirmation in 6 days. Invoice 1 she paid in 3 days with an unprompted screenshot. That divergence is the single thing to watch. Derrek sent zero messages this week; his $40k phone-farm rollout updates, promised Aug 1 to start "next week", are now 20 days silent, though Michelle did finally give her the reel page (itsqueenblake) on Aug 16 and Michelle's weekly leak-removal report landed on time again on Aug 17.

Engagement fully recovered - 32 client messages vs 1 last week, plus same-day delivery on customs, the Zeus shoot and a $6.3k whale request, and explicit praise for the team.
